Summary
Hello! I’m Ghefira Addien, an Information Systems student at
Universitas Brawijaya with a passion for UI/UX design, creative
problem-solving, and digital product development. I enjoy turning
ideas into impactful and user-friendly designs that connect
technology with people.
Throughout my journey, I’ve been actively involved in projects
and competitions, particularly in UI/UX design, which have helped
me sharpen skills in design thinking, prototyping, and visual
communication. I’m also building my personal brand, Gefiranch, to
showcase my works and creativity in digital design.
I’m currently open to opportunities, whether internships, freelance
projects, or collaborations in UI/UX design, product design, or
creative digital work, where I can learn, grow, and contribute
meaningful solutions.
Let’s connect!
